comments.body: So I went to my farm, and the record keeper there does not have this recipe unless it is the artisan. I could check her next. All the record keeper has is dyeing recipe books. If it is the record keeper, how do I get him to have the recipe????

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In looking at the tables from a Japanese wiki, Raisins can be produced at all four private farm locations when you have at least 100 Technology (under the Farm category), and two facilities, at least one of which must be producing Berries.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Privatefarm
